publication.title: HardMagic
audience: Global brand, media, and entertainment leaders
Chief marketing, digital, and transformation officers
publication.thesis: Creative direction, media systems, and generative execution become one accountable operating model.
publication.editorial_promise: Make consequential creative and technology decisions legible, evidence-aware, and ready to move from premise to public experience.
publication.jurisdiction: Global, English-language publication; each brief declares its evidence cutoff and distribution boundary.

creative_direction.selected_thesis: Dream in reality: pair a strong premise with the systems, proof, and human authority that let it survive production.
creative_direction.motion_metaphor: A signal travels from a decision room through an accountable production system into a coherent public world.
creative_direction.deliberate_refusal: No tool-first hype, fabricated client proof, or synthetic certainty where evidence and uncertainty should remain visible.
